summary.text: Andi Morrow is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Michael Lazzara (R).
Morrow owns a cleaning business in eastern North Carolina and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Andi Morrow was born in Orlando, Florida, and earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from East Carolina University in 2017 and 2021, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Morrow wrote of owning a cleaning business in a small coastal town in eastern North Carolina.
Morrow ran for District 6 in 2024, when Michael Lazzara defeated Morrow in the general election.
In the survey, Morrow wrote that the candidate's political opinion comes down to fairness and named democracy, economics and education as the three main policy areas of interest.
